findings.passage: Our elections should be open, honest, and fair.  I want every citizen to have the ability to vote should they choose, but I do not want a single illegal vote cast.  We need to print a readable serial number on every ballot in the State.  We need to ensure that those that have passed do not remain on our voter rolls.
findings.note: From his 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answers (page shows it released 2024-02-02), when he was running for the District 26 seat. He says he wants every citizen able to vote and no illegal votes, and calls for readable serial numbers on ballots and for removing deceased people from the voter rolls.

findings.passage: With election integrity at the forefront of public trust, it’s critical that our voter rolls remain current and accurate,
findings.note: Quote of Morgan in a Katy-area magazine's report (dated 2025-02-13) on his filing of HB 2272; the magazine is the outlet quoting him. He links voter-roll accuracy to public trust in elections.

Filed HB 2272 on confirmation of a voter's residence by a voter registrar: notices to voters inactive for 25 months, with cancellation possible if they stay inactive through two later general elections. Referred to the Elections Committee 2025-03-14.
